head_commit.message:
HIA: qualify resource samples through the current sealed Host lease

Reuse only this hosted job's source-bound production Host parent and reject stale or incomplete prior bindings before locking. Audit all three physical resource reads and the surrounding fresh Host checks, with no fixture or supplied-counter fallback.

Bind the complete 52-input source set, run 18 controller groups before provisioning, and preserve actual native/Rust/trace evidence and prior failures. Keep all 26 original packages and all whole-project retirement gates open.

Reuse only this hosted job's source-bound production Host parent and reject stale or incomplete prior bindings before locking. Audit all three physical resource reads and the surrounding fresh Host checks, with no fixture or supplied-counter fallback.

Bind the complete 52-input source set, run 18 controller groups before provisioning, and preserve actual native/Rust/trace evidence and prior failures. Keep all 26 original packages and all whole-project retirement gates open.
